response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering practices and has relevant education, they are fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. They have minimal C++ experience (6 months at National Instruments, over 10 years ago) and zero background in industrial automation, IoT, or secure development lifecycle practices. Their entire recent career (last 11 years) has been focused on web/full-stack development with JavaScript/TypeScript, moving away from systems programming. This is not a suitable candidate for a senior C++ role in industrial automation.
strengths: Strong software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, and code quality mindset across multiple roles
Proven expertise in React and Node.js (advantageous skills listed in job description)
Demonstrated mentoring ability and technical communication through workshops, courses, and team collaboration
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise: only 6 months at National Instruments (2014-2015), 10+ years ago; role requires senior-level C++ mastery
No background in industrial automation, IoT, industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA), or secure development lifecycle/IEC 62443 standards
Recent 5+ year career trajectory (2020-present) exclusively in JavaScript/TypeScript/web development; no evidence of multi-threading, networking, or systems-level programming focus

key_factors.factor: Missing industrial automation and security domain knowledge
Strong software craftsmanship and mentoring capability
